Quantity.description:
A physical value: a magnitude and the unit it was expressed in.

Construct directly (``Quantity(magnitude=75, unit="kip")``) or parse from
text (``Quantity.parse("75 kip")``). The stored ``unit`` string is exactly
what the user wrote, canonicalized only to Pint's spelling of it.
Quantity.title: Quantity

Regime.description:
Which regulation a walking-working surface is screened against.

Declared, never inferred. The three are not interchangeable: 1926 Subpart M says
different numbers for several of the same things, and a guardrail that passes the
wrong regulation is worse than one nobody checked.
Regime.title: Regime
